translations.web: When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”
translations.bsb: When the daughters returned to their father Reuel, he asked them, “Why have you returned so early today?”
translations.kjv: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to day?
translations.asv: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that ye are come so soon to-day?
